name: Gallinazo
description: Gallinazo is a distinct domino game played in Puerto Rico and parts of Mexico, characterized by its individual play format and unique penalty scoring system. While most domino games focus on partnership play, Gallinazo forces each of the four participants to hunt for themselves. The game is named after the 'vulture' (gallinazo), perhaps referring to the way players must 'prey' on others' mistakes to avoid being the one left holding highndvalue tiles. It is culturally synonymous with social stakes, where the cumulative loser is famously tasked with buying the next round of drinks for the table.

content.text: Gallinazo is a distinct domino game played in Puerto Rico and parts of Mexico, characterized by its individual play format and unique penalty scoring system. While most domino games focus on partnership play, Gallinazo forces each of the four participants to hunt for themselves. The game is named after the 'vulture' (gallinazo), perhaps referring to the way players must 'prey' on others' mistakes to avoid being the one left holding highndvalue tiles. It is culturally synonymous with social stakes, where the cumulative loser is famously tasked with buying the next round of drinks for the table.

Gallinazo is particularly associated with San Lorenzo, Puerto Rico, and Guadalajara, Mexico. It represents an informal, highndvelocity version of dominoes that prioritizes social interaction and 'secret' scoring to keep the tension high until the final round.
Exactly 4 players, each playing for themselves.
Each player receives 7 tiles, leaving no boneyard.
